---

#### **1. Core Innovation**
The core innovation of the paper is the development of a novel method to distinguish between different large language models (LLMs) by analyzing their unique temporal and network behavior. This method leverages **inter-token times** (the time intervals between consecutive tokens generated) and **network traffic analysis** to identify distinct patterns that serve as "fingerprints" for each model.
